title: HRI-Free Research Featured in The Irish Times
excerpt: The Irish Times featured the lab’s ICRA work on cognitive robotic simulation and social attention in an article about the future of AGI and human-AI interaction.

zh.title: HRI-Free 研究获《爱尔兰时报》报道
zh.excerpt: 《爱尔兰时报》在一篇探讨通用人工智能（AGI）与人机交互未来的文章中，介绍了实验室在ICRA发表的认知机器人仿真与社会注意研究。
